datasets.name: branch-service-summary
datasets.sql: select b.branch_name as "branchName", count(*) as "completedVisits", avg(v.duration_minutes)::numeric(10,1) as "averageDurationMinutes" from source_operations.visits v join source_operations.branches b on b.branch_id = v.branch_id where v.completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days' group by b.branch_name order by "completedVisits" desc limit 100
